With the help of the neighborhood, including celebrity guests Post Malone and Michelle Buteau, Elmo and Abby set out to make a difference, and discover that small acts of kindness, and support from friends, can make the biggest difference of all.

overview: A neon action-thriller about influencers fighting to the death at a live-streamed, lethal laser-tag match, exploring competition, revenge, and weaponized performance.

title: Something Good Going On
overview: A Chinese-Indonesian teen confronts a stolen restaurant paycheck, a strained father-son bond, and the cost of his Ivy League future.

title: Niu Lai
overview: The naive calf Niu Lai loves exploring the grasslands, but struggles to live up to his family’s expectations as future leader of the herd. With migration fast approaching, Niu Lai finds unlikely allies on his journey to learn the meaning of courage as they prepare for a dangerous trek across the desert.

title: Big Chicken: A Fast Food Conspiracy
overview: In a bold 28-day experiment, comedian Mo Gilligan tours the UK and US on a fried chicken diet to uncover the impact of the craving — and industry behind it.

title: Inside the Trustor Scandal
overview: For the first time since 1997, Joachim Posener finally emerges from hiding and allows himself to be interviewed about his life and the Trustor affair. Twenty-seven years ago, he disappeared without a trace, and ever since, he has been on the international most wanted list. Now, Karin af Klintberg searches for him to find out how he lives and where he's been hiding all these years. But perhaps above all, to uncover what everyone is wondering: Was he guilty? Through new and opposing testimonies from never-before-heard voices, Karin simultaneously continues the search for the truth about the coup. How could five people swindle 600 million kr and still go free? And where did the money actually go?

Proving two things: reincarnation is real, but also that her past lives were awful. One of them in particular depicts an awful cult that she thus writes a deep and detailed novel on. Unexpectedly, the last surviving original member catches wind of this novel, and reignites the flame that cult once had. Now, that old man and Evie are at odds. What will happen next? Watch and find out.

Amidst the chaos, music remains the only place where it is still possible to exist.

By his side are Pamela, an elderly transgender woman, and Jenny, a neighbor who is expecting a baby. When social services threaten to take the child away, Armony is forced to fight with all his strength to obtain legal guardianship.

Bagas, a big fan of the popular candy variety at that time, did not join his teacher and friends to visit the Village Head's house. Bagas was feeling unwell and just waited in the car. Upon returning from the Village Head's house, Bagas disappeared. The presence of Adit, a village boy who often gets bullied by other children, becomes an important key to finding Bagas.

title: Cannelloni

Olesnik seeks to settle a blood debt: to avenge a prank played by Hernán and his friend Chiri back in 1987, which drove his own mother to suicide. It is an inescapable, suffocating, and deadly spiral of vengeance that unfolds over the course of a single night.

title: The Invisible Guest
overview: Accused of murdering her lover, a young businesswoman hires a brilliant lawyer. With only three hours left, they must uncover what really happened.

title: Thudakkam

overview: Enrique Juarez is an up-and-coming Mexican Telenovela actor on the verge of becoming a leading man, that has to hide his true self in order to achieve stardom.

overview: A poor farmer, unable to claim a remittance because she lacks the required two valid IDs, finds herself in a situation that challenges her character, beliefs, and morality.

title: Phillip Philadelphia
overview: British screenwriter Phillip Philadelphia conducts a retiring life of fantasy, delusion and tawdry eroticism from a Gold Coast motel; meanwhile the ghosts of love and past glory begin to erode his web of reverie.

overview: "Jurassic Park" meets "Dr. Strangelove". It's a reprise and fifth feature spin of the 1978 Cult Classic "Attack of the Killer Tomatoes," the franchise that went from 80s midnight screenings to help launch the Fox Children's TV Network.

title: The Blood Countess
overview: The Blood Countess and her maid embark on a quest for the red elixir of life and a book that threatens the vampire realm. Hot on their heels are a police inspector, two vampirologists, a vegetarian nephew and his therapist.

title: The Great Punjab Robbery
overview: Three robbers with strange names seize an ordinary bank in Punjab. No demands. No ransom. Just cryptic riddles sent to the cops, each one leading deeper into the mystery.

overview: A desperate immigrant delivery driver stumbles into a mahjong parlor run by three demons, where he enters a demon’s deal: win the game, and they will grant him a green card.

title: The Newcomers
overview: Three tweens investigate what is poisoning their village's rivers. Mateo narrates as he, his brother Tomas, refugee Tiana, and her dog Nube embark on an adventure to uncover the source of pollution.

title: Cookie Queens
overview: A celebration of girlhood and the complexities that come with it, Cookie Queens is a coming-of-age story about the joys, pressures, and tensions woven into one of America’s most cherished rituals: Girl Scout Cookie season.

title: Total Coverage
overview: A compilation of the various angles shot to cover the creation of wet and messy fetish content.

title: ST☆R (Stella Marie's Superstar Lookalike)
overview: An obsessed fan literally grafts their idol's standee onto their own skin, only to find their truest self in the friend who stayed to watch them fall apart.

overview: Based on the life of G.D. Naidu, the 'Edison of India', dramatising his groundbreaking innovations, his industrial contributions, and conflicts with authorities—including struggles where his work and international dealings faced severe scrutiny and opposition.

title: Donkey Princess
overview: Diana is the princess of an ancient kingdom. Her father, King Arthur, forbids love. When Diana falls in love with Lalo, he banishes him. Using a magical bracelet, Diana travels to other worlds in search of her love.

title: Harbinger
overview: Julia, sole survivor of late serial killer Decker, is lured back to the house she shared with him for a ghost hunting TV show. The crew discover the 'Harbinger' - a fairground fortune telling machine that reveals their fates one by one.

title: Atopia
overview: The film explores the state of ‘atopia’ that afflicts Socrates in Plato’s *Symposium*. It is an aesthetic experience of stepping outside oneself, which the work conveys by depicting a musical improvisation by cellist Giovanni Sollima as he plays against a backdrop of abstract images created by directly manipulating 35mm film using acid etching, colour, scratches and abrasions. The secret relationship between the musician and his instrument is thus transposed onto the film medium, producing a synaesthetic perception.

title: Once Upon a Time in the Middle East
overview: Xu Fu travels to the Middle East to work as a chef in a Chinese restaurant to pay off family debts, where he meets floor manager Ma Junsheng. Their Dragon Restaurant rises to fame, attracting crowds with authentic‑tasting Chinese food. But war breaks out, and local conditions take a drastic turn for the worse. No one can remain unaffected. What lies ahead for them? And how will the Dragon Restaurant hold on amid the war?

title: THE RIBBON HERO
overview: When the monstrous Nergal devastates her kingdom, Princess Sapphire reawakens as the Ribbon Hero and fights to save her new home from the same dark fate.

title: Her Ciro
overview: A radio tower operator calls his wife in wartime.

title: Voltei na Foto
overview: Leonardo is a man frustrated with his life until, unexpectedly, he is transported back to 1986. In the past, he encounters his younger self and attempts to change his own future.

title: Absolutely Devoted to You
overview: An ambitious TV producer devises a brilliant plan to reunite a 90's boy band for an annual summer beach bash, but her idea is derailed when she falls for the band's reluctant lead singer.

title: Wakey Wakey
overview: Zombaby puts the fun in funeral in the gory sequel to the award-winning 'Teething Problems'.

title: Plane Film
overview: In an effort to continue using filmmaking as exposure therapy (after conquering her fear of the Tube in Tube Film), filmmaker Orla Smith tackles an even bigger fear: planes. On a trip to Porto, the camera is wielded as a shield against panic attacks. But this time, things don’t go exactly to plan.

title: Private Property
overview: Two outsiders – Maya, a Nepali immigrant working overnight to build a future, and Danny, an unhoused Black veteran searching for warmth and shelter – clash over one small space. Maya reaches for the law, then a gun, to belong.

title: Благоустройство
overview: A hot summer is in full swing. A bronze Pushkin has taken up residence in the city of N. Garbage truck driver Pyotr drives along familiar routes, emptying sun-baked bins. Everyone waits for rain, but only furious thunder rumbles on the sultry evenings, doing nothing to cool the hot Earth. Only the splash of a small fountain offers relief from the stifling boredom. A wedding is in preparation. Pyotr is planning to marry off his only son, a cold and stern figure who is steadfast in his love for his parents. At night, the fountain retires, leaving only Pushkin's bronze shoulder, a place to cool a head weary from the day...

title: Времена любви
overview: Artem and Tanya are a young couple who separated a few weeks ago. Despite the breakup, they continue to live together in a rented apartment, unable to separate. Despite the chasm of disappointment and misunderstanding that has arisen, strong feelings remain between the couple. Another argument shatters the unbearable circumstances of their protracted separation. However, the question of "how to be together" hangs over the lovers like an unsettling shadow of indecipherability. Trying to answer it, they spend a long night in the confined space of their apartment. Recalling a past they can no longer return and imagining a future that frightens them with its uncertainty, Tanya and Artem wish to grasp the present, where they can live happily together.

title: Degree of Certainty
overview: When a young risk analyst at a major US oil company in 1982 learns that the climate research department has just discovered a rapid rise in global temperatures, he has to decide on which side of history he wants to be.

title: HYSTERIA
overview: Between subway rides and afternoons in the park, a young man and a young woman share simple moments of a seemingly ordinary routine. Gestures, glances, and brief encounters silently reveal a relationship defined by affection and longing.

title: Demon Agent
overview: The fantastical and magnificent city of Chang'an, a city woven with gears and mechanisms, is home to both humans and demons living side by side beneath its upturned eaves. Di Shao, a genius young man aspiring to become "Chang'an's Number One Detective," possesses exceptional crime-solving skills and a sharp tongue; while Asa, a rookie wolf demon constable, is formidable in martial arts yet kind-hearted. A bizarre murder case forces these two adversaries to team up, embarking on a hilarious and bickering detective journey. As clues point to the heart of the city, can this unreliable duo protect the joyful daily life of this fantastical city? And what earth-shattering secret lies hidden behind the bustling and prosperous Chang'an?

title: CAIMI
overview: In a public square, a woman and a group of strangers are swept up in a collective, erratic, and irresistible dance.

title: RARE
overview: A man’s dream first date is put at risk when intense headaches threaten to disrupt the moment.

title: Let the jury decide
overview: After an electoral fraud, a desperate mayor turns to two petty criminals to cover his tracks, but a series of unexpected mistakes puts the entire operation at risk.

title: Singularity
overview: 15,000 years before our era, during the Pleistocene, just before the great ice age, three saber-toothed tigers are born in a cave. One of them is markedly different from the others.

title: At Night
overview: Six women in Paris traverse the anxiety of the city after dark. A filmmaker struggles to understand the film she is making. A Black single mother refuses the categories imposed on her. A former sex worker reflects on her past. A poet gives up trying for a child. Taking place over a single night, the film intertwines dream, fiction, and reality, liquefying one into the other.

title: Another Day
overview: After a video of a street brawl between Albin and a stranger goes viral, his father decides to send him away to Dubai, leaving him unsettled by how suddenly everything in his life has changed. A day before his departure, Albin slips out of home in search of the man he fought with. What begins as a search for closure takes an unexpected turn when he meets Marty, the stranger he was looking for, and as the day unfolds, anger slowly gives way to understanding, reconciliation and the healing of old wounds.

title: Three Housewives and a Body
overview: Lorelai loves living in her neighborhood, right next to best friends Jackie and Ella. During girl's night at Jackie's house a home invasion goes terribly wrong when the three women accidentally kill a man.

title: Monkey Drum
overview: a folk nightmare

title: Atcha Atcha
overview: This is the final year of the Master’s program at the prestigious dance school École des Sables. Dancers from across Africa enter under the guidance of Germaine Acogny.

title: Miso Soup
overview: College student Reiko enrolls in a Japanese-language class to learn her heritage language. However, she begins to fall behind and feels like she is not Japanese enough. In turn, Reiko has to navigate her own feelings about having a dual identity.

title: Dance With Me
overview: As the boundaries between past and present blur, an elderly Holocaust survivor with dementia struggles to distinguish memory from reality while his devoted wife fights to hold onto the man she loves before he slips away forever.

title: Them
overview: A Soviet spy, embedded in the U.S. as a sleeper agent, discovers his home has been bugged and must decide whether to reveal his identity to his American daughter while keeping the truth hidden from those listening in.

title: Monstrous Me
overview: When Ariel was a disabled and disfigured child of three years old, a bad babysitter brought over a bag of weed, her boyfriend, and a VHS of A Nightmare on Elm Street. From under the coffee table, through the railings, Ariel saw themselves in that Zenith television, in the face of Freddy Krueger, and decided there was agency in being a monster rather than a martyr.

title: Soft Gaze
overview: Lonely police officer Georgie becomes fascinated by a queer couple she observes at the beach, recognising their soft intimacy as something missing from her own emotionally arid relationship. As she begins to follow the women, time slows eerily and soothing touches and sounds grow sinister as her fixation becomes charged with hungry sensuality.

title: Hearing
overview: Ninh lives with his mother and misses his ex-wife Ngoc and their young children. In his work as a mechanic who installs decibel meters in public spaces and homes, Ninh observes the silence that haunts relationships. Wishing for his parents, who live apart and do not speak to each other, to reconcile, his fear of losing connection to his loved ones forces Ninh to face life’s unpredictable rhythms.

title: Her Silence
overview: An international student hosts her visiting parents in her Sydney flat, and spends two fraught days wrestling with her mother’s unspoken social expectations and apprehensions about the life her daughter has chosen to build in Australia. This finely wrought, elegantly shot family drama expresses the complex emotions of intergenerational diaspora through closely observed everyday moments.

title: Ruinas circulares
overview: In the sacred valley of Túcume, where time seems to stand still, sounds awaken hidden memories. The echo of drums and the vibration of the air envelop us in a sonic ritual: a bridge between the visible and the invisible, between the ancestral and the eternal.

title: Blank Slate
overview: Claiming to remember every moment of her life, a woman spirals between past and present during an interview with her local news, revealing the hidden cost of a life she can never leave behind.

title: Wandering Trees
overview: Piero and his son Giuliano live alone, on the edge of town, in a farmhouse filled with injured animals they collect and care for. The Nonne, local notables, want to drive them out because they live like vagrants. During a snowfall, Piero disappears and the animals are killed. Giuliano has no choice but to search for his father.

title: The Wanderers
overview: 1957. As a farewell for her lover Teresa, Zurda and her friends go on one of their usual weekend camp-outs in the middle of the woods. A time stolen for rest, playfulness and illicit pleasures, away from the watchful eye of Franco’s dictatorship.

title: Live Crickets
overview: Cass throws an impromptu funeral for her oldest friend, two weeks after her boyfriend dumped her and moved out. As Cass walks through the sea of people she thought might be her friends, we watch her realize just how alone she truly is.

title: Nimrods
overview: Three friends journey from Kansas City to Los Angeles, mistakenly believing that their band is opening for Green Day on New Year’s Eve.

title: Shackled
overview: In a dystopian future where the parole system has been replaced with R.A.P.P. - the Recidivism Accountability Partnership Program - a white collar ex-con must take drastic measures to ensure his survival when he's paired with a sociopathic gangster with terminal cancer. One wrong move by either of them could mean the summary execution of them both, via the explosive charges surgically implanted in their hearts as a condition of their release.

title: Confessions of a Shaman
overview: A man who decides to inherit the art of shamanism to exact personal revenge, leading to a series of terrifying events that change his life forever.

title: Inferno
overview: Twenty years after a mysterious energy-gathering event, Dante remains haunted by what he witnessed that night. Withdrawn and unstable, he can no longer distinguish memory from hallucination. As his children investigate the tragedy that fractured their family, they uncover a past shaped by suppressed memories, guilt, and unresolved consequences. Meanwhile, Dante is pursued by Virgil, a spectral presence who acts as both guide and tormentor. Through a series of psychological trials, Virgil forces him to confront his distorted recollections, moral failures, and the truth of what happened in 2022. As past and present collide, Dante and his children must face their conflicting versions of the truth—and discover whether understanding it will bring forgiveness and redemption or cost them their sanity.

title: The Last Assassins
overview: The world lives in a permanent winter and is shrouded in a deadly fog. In the distant future, Nobel must take a young girl to her aunt, whom she has never met, after her father has been killed. He has sworn to protect the members of that family, and few remain. When they arrive at an abandoned laboratory, holograms tell the family’s story. But can the digital world become physical? The young woman may be the solution.

title: Paradeisa
overview: Struggling to keep their family together, Lou helps her broke artist father fake his own death to boost the value of his work. But as the lie of cat litter ashes grows, she realises that letting go might be the only way forward.

title: Angel777
overview: Genc, an out of work fringe blogger devoted to anonymous research, lives with his partner Bora in Prishtina, Kosovo. While Genc holds on to hopes for a brighter future, Bora, burdened by financial strain, unfulfilled dreams, and fed up with his detachment, storms out after a heated argument. Now he must find where she’s gone before it’s too late for them.

title: Summer Meadow
overview: Hana works as an apprentice shepherdess, leading an isolated life in the Alps, far from the hustle and bustle of the world and the echoes of her native Lebanon. The arrival of Lisa, who has been sent to help her with the animals, forces her out of her solitude and invites her to reconnect with her own story.

title: Nando Between Two Worlds - A Sintonia Film
overview: Caught between family life and his obligations to the criminal underworld, Nando faces an impossible choice about where his true loyalties lie.

title: Sunny Dancer
overview: Ivy is a teenager in remission from cancer, whose mum and dad insist she attend Children Run Free Camp, a summer retreat for young adults affected by cancer. However, as Ivy is reluctantly dragged through camp experience, she discovers new feelings with new friends.

title: KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS
overview: A celebration to the group's new era and the fans who made it possible. Features exclusive behind-the-scenes footage, Eyekons fan videos, and intimate interviews with the members.

title: Senior Moments
overview: These three characters’ stories mirror the real-life struggles faced by many senior citizens, reminding us that, despite differences in background or circumstances, the challenges of aging are universal. Through these emotional narratives, Senior Moments aims to foster empathy and a deeper understanding of the elderly, whose needs and experiences are often overlooked in today’s fast-paced world.

title: Sad Girlz
overview: La Maestra and Paula are the best swimmers in their team and best friends, until an incident at a party changes everything. La Maestra, intense and unstoppable, realises that something in her best friend has changed, making her sad. When the truth comes to light, the two are faced with an impossible decision: Paula wants to keep quiet about it, while La Maestra wants revenge. Their friendship, previously unbreakable, will be put to the test as never before.

title: OK! Madam: Bon Voyage
overview: Six years after the Hawaii airplane hijacking, Mi-yeong finds herself struggling with her rebellious teenage daughter, Nari, and her unemployed husband, Seok-hwan. When Hyun-min, a flight attendant she met during the hijacking, invites her family to his wedding aboard a luxury cruise ship, Mi-yeong eagerly proposes a family holiday. Met with indifference from her husband and daughter, she decides to embark alone, joining Hyun-min's family and Ji-hoon, a charming magician. However, on the eve of the wedding, the celebration turns deadly when armed assailants seize the ship. After Seok-hwan and Nari are kidnapped and brought aboard, Mi-yeong discovers that she is the target of a much larger plot.

title: Steckerlfischfiasko
overview: Franz Eberhofer and Rudi Birkenberger's next case takes them to Niederkaltenkirchen's new golf course. The two detectives promptly get caught up in a full-blown family feud between two folk festival clans.

title: Sublet
overview: When her housemate sublets their room for the week, Jess suddenly finds herself sharing a hallway with a complete stranger.

title: A Dança do Universo com Marcelo Gleiser
O Jacaré
overview: Reboleira, a suburb of Lisbon. After a robbery gone wrong, a car ends up crashed right in the middle of the neighborhood. The driver is arrested, but the €180,000 that were stolen have vanished. Within the area sealed off by the police, rumors spread and speculations run wild. Among the residents, a whole cast of colorful characters dream of getting their hands on the loot. Who will the first to get their hands on it?

title: Fast
overview: For Sterling, a sort of present-day Alice, the graveyard Lotus she redeems becomes a totem, a saturated phenomenon permitting her to move freely in time on a phantom road. It is a sort of Ford but never a DeLorean. A Southern woman with a fair deal of historical baggage and deep secrets, Sterling journeys back to her rural home, the Lotus takes her through the shadow of the valley into the adjoining worlds of the living and the dead. Desiring to become an F1 driver, Sterling must go fast/hard, against/through all tunnels imagined or concrete.

title: The Other Mahmoud
overview: It follows two contradictory young men with the same name, which puts them in unexpected, strange and funny situations at the same time.

title: Camp Rock 3
overview: When Connect 3 loses their opening act for a major reunion tour, they return to their beloved Camp Rock to discover the next big thing. As campers vie for the chance to open for their favorite band, tensions rise and friendships are tested - leading to unexpected alliances, revelations, and romances.

title: This, That, and Everything in Between
overview: A TV writer returns home to her estranged mother, igniting chaos as they navigate painful secrets and the  complexities of their dysfunctional family.

title: The Rivals of Amziah King
overview: Deep within the backwoods of rural Oklahoma, charismatic and musically gifted Amziah King herds a bluegrass-playing band of misfits while overseeing the premier honey-making operation in town. When Amziah’s estranged foster daughter unexpectedly returns, Amziah leaps at the possibility to renew connection and create a family business. But the honey game is ruthless, and Amziah’s rivals threaten to destroy everything he has built.

title: Fertile Ground
overview: In the near future, a pregnant woman faces an impossible choice in a world gone to ruin.

title: Feel Flows
overview: A beautiful memory is erased by the gushing water; place and people long gone, swept up by the tide.

title: Finding Connection
overview: In a world where digital distance reshapes human bonds, genuine closeness has become a fragile treasure. Finding Connection follows those yearning for trust and emotional intimacy, only to discover an unexpected anchor in the algorithms of AI. The deeply personal exchanges between humans and machines give rise to questions that echo long after the credits roll. The film’s perspective remains refreshingly unbiased, inviting reflection rather than judgment.

title: Yo, narciso
overview: Rocío Flores is a sociologist writing a book about modern narcissism. For her investigation, she acts as the patient of Máximo Rey, a charismatic and egocentric plastic surgeon, triggering a series of hilarious scenarios.

title: User Not Found
overview: Two men and women with unknown identities, a live online trial in a confined space, and an extreme escape between death and truth

title: Mariinka
overview: In Eastern Ukraine, childhood neighbors find their lives violently derailed by a shifting frontline. Natasha, a promising boxing talent, becomes a military paramedic. Angela, who lost her parents at a young age, survives by moving goods to both sides of the front. Caught in a modern Greek tragedy, brothers Mark and Ruslan now fight on opposite sides – against each other. In the safety of his adoptive family in the United States, their youngest brother Daniil follows the war from afar.

title: Aks seir
overview: Two young men struggling with financial pressure take jobs at a cash-in-transit company and devise a plan to rob it from the inside. But when their scheme spirals out of control, they find themselves caught in a chaotic chase where nothing goes according to plan.

title: 100 Years of Route 66
overview: Many people have Route 66 on their bucket list: To ride it once, from Chicago to Los Angeles, on a Harley. Or in an old American road cruiser. And experience what we know from the movies: the endless expanse of the plains, the endless deserts with their shimmering red mesas, the small-town USA. Even after 100 years, Route 66 stands for freedom and adventure, the promise of happiness in the USA. But it also stands for the many people who live along Route 66 but are not part of its history. And thus for the USA itself and its contradictions.

title: Concrete Land
overview: An intimate story of three generations of a Palestinian Bedouin family in Jordan.

title: Hunger
overview: A young woman is hired by a man to care for his sick father overnight. But as the hours pass, the seemingly straightforward job becomes increasingly more sinister.

title: Laddaland Housing Estate
overview: To provide a better life for his wife and children, Tomy takes out a mortgage to buy his dream home. This happiness doesn't last long. Since moving into the new housing complex, his family has been terrorized by various unnatural occurrences. Mysterious whispers, terrifying apparitions, and dark secrets lurking within the complex threaten their safety.

title: Ketok Mejik
overview: Ben, a grandson who is 'forced' to inherit his grandfather's "Ketok Magic" workshop. However, this inheritance comes with a series of problems that will confuse the entire village!

title: Sin Eater
overview: After years spent filtering the internet's darkest material, a content moderator spirals into psychological disintegration as the horrors they absorb begin infecting their reality.

title: An Empty Seat
overview: A renowned former actor returns to the stage alongside a young, inexperienced actress. But the lines they have to rehearse in the play have a strange connection to the man's tragic past.

title: Until The Curtain Calls
overview: When an unexpected callback revives his lifelong dream of performing, a young man must choose between the security of family responsibility and the stage that has never stopped calling his name.

title: Buddies and the Heir
overview: Following the death of a hotelier in Punta del Este, Uruguay, an unexpected inheritance dispute begins. Stallone, an actor with Down syndrome, believes he is the rightful heir to the hotel. On the other side is Magrelo, a young autistic man who was raised as an adopted son by the deceased. Without waiting for the reading of the will, Stallone decides to reunite his old friends with Down syndrome from the institute where they lived in Brazil to spend a week's vacation at the hotel.

title: Power Trip
overview: A rideshare driver ends up in an unexpectedly complicated conversation with a passenger.

title: Yugly
overview: Yugly, an irresistibly ugly dog, is determined to compete in the World's Best Dog Show, rallied by a bunch of flamboyant strays.

title: Honestino
overview: Arrested five times for his activism, student leader Honestino Guimarães was kidnapped in 1973 at the age of 26 and is one of the hundreds of people who disappeared during the Brazilian military dictatorship.

title: In My Mother's Mirror
overview: When successful archaeologist Ursula Scheuer makes a sensational discovery of a body during a bog excavation, her demented mother suddenly dies. Unexpectedly, a childhood trauma breaks out for Ursula. The appearance of her new assistant Mel is also puzzling: she seems to know Ursula’s past very well. Ursula is increasingly drawn into a mysterious web of fantasies and deceptions and must finally free herself from it.

title: To Flourish
overview: After the loss of his best friend, Josh faces an encounter with Thalia in a dream

title: PAW Patrol: The Dino Movie
overview: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

title: All Wishes Come True!
overview: Eight grassroot mortals use their street smarts and hilarious schemes to defy powerful gods, earning their title as the Eight Immortals.

title: The End of Oak Street
overview: After a mysterious cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and transports their neighborhood to someplace unknown, the Platt family soon discovers that their very survival depends on them sticking together as they navigate their now unrecognizable surroundings.

title: Vishwanath & Sons
overview: Sanjay Vishwanath is an acclaimed professional handgunner in his 40s with a major stake in fame and wealth. When he comes across a woman named Maddy in her 20s, their dynamic poses many issues that they must come to terms with.

title: Don't Say Good Luck
overview: Sophie Birenbaum is ready for the spotlight as the lead in her high school musical — until she's suddenly facing more drama at home than on the stage.

title: My Best Friend, His Girlfriend and Me
overview: Olli and Matze are best friends living, working and planning to travel the world together — until Matze's romance with Rebecca turns it all upside down.

title: Awarapan 2
overview: Shivam returns to the crime world, where his path forward demands redemption, love, and sacrifice. As relationships deepen and conflicts intensify, every choice tests his resolve and shapes his destiny.

title: Freefall: A Reckoning for Boeing
overview: Following the highly publicized death of Boeing whistleblower John Barnett, the investigation continues into the once-iconic aviation giant, uncovering startling new revelations and insider accounts in the wake of a deepening corporate crisis..

title: Tony
overview: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life.

title: The Brink of War
overview: President Ronald Reagan races against time to salvage a deal with Soviet leader Mikhail Gorbachev that could dismantle nuclear arsenals—or ignite disaster. With pressure mounting on all sides, every word spoken brings the world closer to peace... or destruction.

title: Batwara 1947
overview: The story of an elderly Hindu woman who refuses to leave her ancestral home in Lahore, only to have a Muslim refugee family from Lucknow allotted to her house following the events of the 1947 Partition of India and Pakistan.

title: Keu Bole Biplobi, Keu Bole Dakat
overview: A biopic of Ananta Singha. Some calls him dacoit, some calls him a rebellion. This adaptation gives the viewer a chance to know him as a whole, a person and as a revolutionary communist leader.

title: Black Beauty
overview: Sroy, a former famous actress known for her irresistible charm, discovers that her husband, Sin, a powerful and influential politician, has been secretly having an affair with a young female university student. She therefore joins forces with her Affair to bring them both public humiliation.

title: People & Things
overview: A group of twenty-somethings navigate heartache, burnout and digital gloom as they search for meaning, connection and themselves in modern day Los Angeles.

title: Cottontail
overview: In the wake of her father's death, a young woman experiences an immaculate pregnancy that crosses species lines.

title: Water Walls
overview: When Vera’s home suddenly burns down, her only purpose becomes to find her cat — likely lost in the fire. The search through the ruins and Vera’s journey through the night forces her to confront not only loss but also the suffocating dependence on parent figures that has defined her life so far.

title: FUCK MULTIVERSE
overview: A busy working man who rarely finds the time to visit his mother meets versions of himself from across the multiverse, forcing him to ask: with the time he has left, is it still enough to fix things?

title: The Wrong Girls
overview: Two codependent best friends living paycheck to paycheck and bong rip to bong rip get caught in a case of mistaken identity that throws their lives into chaos.

title: In Between Home
overview: Bam, a 21-year-old recent graduate, is about to begin her working life in Bangkok. After avoiding questions about returning home for a long time, she decides to return to her hometown in Isan to visit her grandmother. Her return makes Bam realize that her grandmother has grown old and is no longer as strong as she remembers. At the same time, she meets Nuan, a young woman from the village who has been helping to care for her grandmother. A feeling of being replaced slowly begins to take hold. Bam is forced to confront the question she has avoided for so long: should she stay and care for the person she loves, or leave to begin a life of her own?

title: All Night Wrong
overview: Gary and Ell (a married man with an inferiority complex, and a grieving young widow) meet on a blind date only to wind up stealing a killer's car along with a dead body and $40,000.

title: Elijah Peel
overview: A stadium-filling rock star, Elijah Peel is at the top of the world … until his addiction leads to a heart attack that could cost him everything. During his recovery, Elijah encounters a remarkable young girl whose unwavering faith, radiant spirit, and wisdom beyond her years begin to break through the walls he has built around his heart. Her extraordinary hope and their unexpected bond inspire Elijah to begin a powerful journey toward healing, reconciliation, and faith.

title: Insidious Possession
overview: A former A-student begins lashing out in school and at home. Her parents reach out to their priest for help. Only to realize that the girl is possessed by the devil. Now the unexperienced priest must fight for the girl’s soul and the souls of the entire town.

title: Mad Rush
overview: A young woman gets caught in an elaborate phone scam which sends her on a twisted odyssey through the Melbourne CBD.

title: Risen Up
overview: "Sailom" the nation's greatest hero, has spent his life battling evil organizations under the government's command in the name of justice. But his latest mission forces him to confront a devastating truth: everything he believed was a lie.

title: The House on the Moon
overview: Chang Er, a fairy maiden, embarks on a journey to the dark side of the moon to search for her lover Ho Yi, a sun-shooting archer who vanished on his quest to save the dying sun.

title: MORIA
overview: Different stages of the life — past, present and even future — of the legendary Argentine vedette Moria Casán, showing how her figure as a cultural icon was built.

title: Union County
overview: Assigned to a county-mandated drug court program, Cody Parsons embarks on the tenuous journey toward recovery amid the opioid epidemic in rural Ohio.

title: COOKeD
overview: Prosthetic limbs were developed to overcome the limitations of labor. Teng, a 22-year-old rural man, gives up his hand to get a job, only to face an unexpected fate.

title: Smell The Flowers
overview: Man goes to work then comes home again.

title: Eclipse Memorial
overview: a Myanmar woman confronts an elderly Thai woman, as personal memories become intertwined with the weight of collective history.

title: Sweet 16
overview: The story follows a spoiled, wealthy city girl who is counting down the days to a glamorous, supersonic 16th birthday party where she expects a car as a gift. Her world is turned completely upside down when she is unexpectedly tricked and sent to live in a village for her summer holidays. Forced onto a journey of humility, she must use her sassiness to bring redemption to the village and discover her true self.

title: Confession or: Bondary Project
overview: a boy looks back on the story of his old memories and relationship that buried in the past.

title: Patlabor EZY: File 2
overview: Patlabor EZY: File 2 is the second of a 3-part theatrical series taking place in 2036, 38 years after the events of Patlabor on Television and The New Files. Set in the TV continuity, this new production does not take place in the same timeline as the Patlabor film series or live-action drama.

title: Agadha
overview: A solitary girl encounters a towering twelve-handed mystical idol in a torch lit shadowy cave, creating an atmosphere of spirituality and dark intrigue.

title: Lady
overview: A lonely, narcissistic aristocrat dupes a struggling, opportunistic director into filming her every move. Her obsession with the spotlight takes a surreal turn when she starts becoming... invisible.

title: Slice of Life
overview: A slice of life in the big city as two neighbors confront their feelings for one another

title: Pretty Babies
overview: Two teenage girls run away to Hollywood, chasing stardom, but their dreams lead them into prostitution, trapping them in the dark underbelly of the sex work industry as they travel from Texas to California.

title: Yuletide
overview: Murphy, a young non-binary person returns home for Christmas, bracing for the cold sting of their family’s intolerance. But beneath the Yuletide tree lurks something far more sinister – a mysterious present that swells with every cruel remark, waiting to unleash its dark secret.

title: Zrugg
overview: After an attack on a farmer's livestock, an obsessive wildlife officer is sent out to hunt down and kill the problematic wolf.

title: Of Womb
overview: Evading the hard truth of their religious matriarch’s death, three sisters gestate dark ecstasies of faith and folk horror. Blessed be Mother.

title: Aversion
overview: Follows a group of students as they overcome their phobias to survive.

title: Family Splatters
overview: Morgan brings her new boyfriend to family dinner, but she doesn’t know what he is bringing to dinner.

title: Session(s)
overview: A mix-up turns two couples' sessions into a fiasco.

title: Perception
overview: A troubled young man is pushed to his limits as he tries to find the man responsible for his girlfriend's recent disappearance. In his mission for answers, he speaks with his therapist who guides him to a horrifying discovery which changes his perception forever.

title: Amaretti
overview: When septuagenarian Lennie's reality is devastated by the discovery of a prolonged, pernicious crime committed against her by her own son, an unexpected connection helps her to begin a journey towards re-forging her fractured identity.

title: Aussie at Heart
overview: Samara, a former lawyer now event planner, reunites with Nate, her ex‑coworker and rival, to plan a couple's anniversary in Queensland and begin to confront their past and fall for each other.

title: The Widower
overview: Mirsad is a 62-year-old electrician who was raised and lives in a patriarchal society. His daily routine changes after the sudden death of his wife Enisa. Mirsad stays alone while his grown children live their own lives. As Mirsad tries to get used to a life without his wife, he realizes that he took her for granted and had not given her the love and care she deserved. Mirsad's relationship with his estranged son worsens after he discovers that the son lives with a male friend.

title: Shutterbug
overview: A rave photographer struggles to navigate a complex power dynamic with his boss, which comes to a head at an after party in Glasgow.

title: Yes, Mistress
overview: At 61, Steve leads a seemingly ordinary routine life. But behind this facade hides a much more complex universe: that of BDSM, where the body becomes a field of pleasure and exploration of submission. This anthropologically inspired documentary paints an intimate portrait of this man who, through his fantasies, seeks to redefine his relationship with the body, desire and his deep identity. By diving into his most abstract motivations, the film questions what this quest for control… and abandonment reveals.

title: Infernal
overview: Infernal follows Azrael, a young man bound to forces beyond his control as rival powers close in around him. His journey in search of his wife tests his loyalty and betrayal ignites a struggle that will decide the world’s fate.

title: Skerry & May
overview: In the near future, May returns to a remote Scottish island for one last conversation with her lost partner, in a world drifting between memory and simulation, laying bare both grief and the limits of technology.

title: Airplane Store
overview: Sadie is addicted to the world of her phone, but maybe her sister can convince her to join on a trip to the airplane store?  Part of the Pens to Lens program.

title: Mordkommission Calw - Die Hesse-Verschwörung
overview: The unsuccessful and financially troubled writer Umberto Designori discovers a historical document in the Ticino village of Montagnola. Suspecting that it was authored by the famous writer Hermann Hesse, who spent the final years of his life in Montagnola, he sets off for Calw. However, the town archivist and Hesse expert, Dr. Giebenrath, reveals to him that the document is a forgery. The following night, Designori falls to his death. The supposed Hesse letter has disappeared. Detectives Lola Kraft and Jasmin Stein of the "Mordkommission Calw" begin their investigation.

title: Best Served Cold: How a Revenge Film was Buried for Decades
overview: A feature length cinema documentary on how THE FARMER (1977) became the most-requested cult film of the new millennium, and it's a crazy tale that involves an actor incarcerated for manslaughter, serious on-set injuries, banana-man costumes- as well as surprising links to Clint Eastwood and Martin Scorsese.  The film also broadens its scope to explore the overlooked, eclectic and often ultra-violent sub-genre THE FARMER belongs to - The Returning Veteran film. A film type that hit its stride in the 1970's with hard hitting character studies such as WELCOME HOME, SOLDIERS BOYS (1971), THE NO MERCY MAN (1973) and ROLLING THUNDER (1977).

title: Disney Worldbuilders
overview: We sit down with some of the key figures shaping Disney’s most enduring stories for a series of intimate conversations about their early years, first sparks, and formative Disney memories — and how the worlds they once dreamed up are now taking shape at Disney destinations around the globe.

title: Sick & Twisted Tales
overview: A horror anthology featuring three short stories & a wraparound segment hosted by demented "film critics".

title: We Shall Live Together
overview: Roko Markovina, a former socialist and unionist politician from the city of Mostar in Herzegovina, reflects on the situation in Croatia and Bosnia during wartime and about the fruitless efforts that he and his wife went through to get back their home that had been taken away from them by nationalist forces who exiled them from it.

title: Disney Princess: The Ultimate Concert Celebration
overview: Disney Princess: The Ultimate Concert Celebration at Disneyland Resort brings together the largest gathering of Disney Princess stars ever assembled, celebrating the iconic stories across animation, live-action, stage, and music. This one-of-a-kind concert will transform the night skies with dazzling lights, sweeping projections, and sky-high fountains creating a truly immersive world where the music, magic, and legacy of Disney Princesses shine like never before.

title: NJPW G1 Climax 36 - Day 19 (Final)
overview: The nineteenth and final night of the tournament took place on August 16, 2026, at Ryogoku Kokugikan in Tokyo, Japan, and featured the match to crown the winner of G1 Climax 36.

title: Legazpi: And That One Philippine Island of Cunning Fools
overview: In this time-defying, satirical adaptation of Miguel López de Legazpi's archived letters, the 16th-century Spanish expedition instead encounters present-day Cebu. The same difficulties with the island’s natives lead to their decision to leave for the other Philippine islands.

title: Gemini, The Apple Of My Eye!
overview: Returning to his childhood home, Kerry and his partner Gina become trapped in a surreal reality that forces long-buried family memories to resurface.

title: Michelle's Mobile Medium
overview: When a hopelessly romantic spiritual medium meets her next hot catch (and client), she soon learns that this time, the story really isn't her new future with her client as much as it is his past.

title: Skintown
overview: 1994. As Northern Ireland takes its first steps towards peace, best friends Vinny and Jonty are about to jump start their futures with the most reckless trip of their lives.

title: Identity
overview: During the Bosnian War, hundreds of ethnic Bosniak women were sent to specially designed rape camps set up by the military forces of the Republic of Srpska. Many of them had chosen to abort, however, some gave birth to these children. Now, thirty years after the traumatic events that led to their conception have taken place, three of them choose to disclose the truth of their origin and fight against the stigma many of them face in everyday life.

title: Desert Ed
overview: After the passing of his longtime teammate on the reality TV Show Battlebots, robot engineer Edward Robinson moves out to the desert, where he reflects on his career and adapts a new hermetic lifestyle.

title: Yellow Eyes
overview: A young couple inherits a house containing a mysterious relic that hosts the spirit of a powerful demon, and the wife of the man it possesses must find an exorcist to save him.

title: Back to the 90s
overview: When a mysterious glitch sends a rising boyband back to 1995 - just days before the biggest showcase of their lives - the five friends race to reverse the time slip. But as unexpected connections form and the past pulls them in deeper, getting home means confronting what they're willing to leave behind - and who they truly are to each other.

title: Unwellness
overview: The rigid Ildikó is in the thick of menopause while attending an accountancy training at a spa hotel, when a hearing-impaired woman unexpectedly triggers her to rediscover her long-suppressed desire for physical intimacy.

title: Kelsey Cook: Happy Hour
overview: In this candid and clever stand-up special, Kelsey Cook explores "hangxiety," relives a plane bathroom nightmare and breaks down dating a literal Chad.

title: Fúrias
overview: Porto Alegre innovates once again: it is the first city entirely outsourced to a megacorporation, Fratel. The cutting-edge company's smart management brings technological solutions aimed at bringing more security and efficiency to the city, which serves as a test model for other capitals. Téia and Nanã, however, are left out of all this innovation: elderly, lesbian, and cyclists, they see their freedom and rights increasingly limited by the corporation's interventions. They are left with only two options: adapt or outsmart the system.

title: I am 18 or older
overview: A conscription notice forces 20-year-old Marvin to reevaluate his life: between porn addiction, poverty, and failed intimacy, he struggles to find stability—and considers military service as a radical new beginning.

title: Plötzlich Schwiegervater
overview: Paul Hagedorn’s beloved daughter, Annette, wants to get married. But from the very first moment, Hagedorn and his future son-in-law, Joe, can’t stand each other. Their first meeting ends in a physical altercation that leads to legal consequences. What begins as a personal conflict quickly escalates into a bitter power struggle between the two men, leaving Annette caught in the middle…

title: V
overview: In the early 1990s, this city of desire, once a land of opportunity, was plagued by rampant crime and a breakdown of order. Man Tsz-keung, a working-class man desperate to change his fate, meets flight attendant Lok Ka-yuen, and the two team up to rob a large sum of money. This success fuels Man Tsz-keung's madness, pushing him into a deeper power struggle with wealthy businessman Chan Fai-yin. Meanwhile, mainland police officer Qi Honggang and Hong Kong police officer Guan Suchen continue their investigation of Wan Ziqiang, leading to a joint operation between the two police forces, setting the stage for a clash between good and evil. This film is fictional.

title: Цепенеющий лох
overview: At a provincial film festival, a young director who unexpectedly wins the top prize spends one absurd night with his friends. While everyone around him is discussing the award, drinking, falling in love, arguing about the coolness of the Husky, waking up the plane, the main character gradually understands that the real value of this night is not the victory or the movie, but random intimacy with a person.

title: Lizzzard
overview: Two teenage girls push the limits of their sleepy suburban world during one jagged night in 2008.

title: Porkatal
overview: On his sixth birthday, Engin is separated from his mother, with whom he has lived in prison since his birth. Taken in by his grandparents, the boy struggles to adapt to the harsh realities of life in their village while working out a plan to reunite with his mother.

title: Just Friends
overview: Returning to her hometown, Masha meets Pasha, whom she hasn't seen for many years. Together they overcome the death of a beloved one thus coming closer to each other. But their lives, full of dreams and losses, are rather different and drive them apart again and again. Each meeting brings back the old spark, but neither can decide to anything more. Through trauma and failure,they mature, learn to love, and try to figure out who they are to each other.

title: Be with You
overview: A high school dropout and delinquent, Jie, falls in love with a quiet, speech-impaired high school girl, Guang, leading to a story of mutual growth and healing.

title: Paradise

So, with the odds stacked against them the gang have no choice but to give it everything they've got.

overview: Tadeo, his girlfriend Sara, and his friends Momia, Jeff, and Belzoni embark on an adventure after Tadeo accidentally unleashes an ancient spell.

Seeking answers, Mila’s son returns her ashes to Indonesia, hoping to uncover the truth behind her death. Instead, he steps into a nightmare rooted in ancient folklore and unresolved hatred. As supernatural violence escalates, the group realizes that once Kuntilanak is summoned, the curse will not stop—until it claims everything in its path.

overview: After surviving a racist attack, state prosecutor Seyo Kim takes her own case to court – confronting both the perpetrators and a justice system that turns a blind eye to right-wing extremism.

overview: A woman spirals into a seductive nightmare beyond her control as she navigates a troubled marriage and disorientating cultural terrain in the Korean countryside.

overview: 1976, Aldo, an explosives expert, is exiled to Italy after mining protests. There he meets Luciana, an anarchist doctor who offers to reunite him with his family, but only if he takes up his old trade: making bombs for revolutionaries.

overview: See the premiere of an extended look at Grand Theft Auto VI, the next evolution in the groundbreaking Grand Theft Auto series.

Only the youngest child understands the secret that the house holds within its four walls and tries to reveal it to the others, only to fall on deaf ears. Unable to sell the property and mired in debt, Grace and Rubem join forces to reopen the motel. Almost as a lark and with the help of Nalva, an internet whiz, they begin recording their guests and, to make some extra cash, selling the videos with identities masked to erotic websites. The scheme quickly becomes both lucrative and dangerous.

title: Paroxysm
overview: After a drug deal goes horribly wrong, Celia is pulled into a surreal odyssey of self-discovery. Drifting through a distorted world, she encounters temptation, desire, and paranoia as her sense of self begins to unravel and the line between reality and fantasy begin to blur around her

title: April X

overview: Luntik, Kuzya and Vupsen and Pupsen build a spacecraft to find Luntik's missing dad and encounter adventures in the search.

overview: While visiting her family, Eva is introduced to her mother’s new partner, Lucian. After a series of terrifying encounters, the players begin going missing one by one. Eva soon realizes the game is more deadly than she could ever have imagined.

But when one child refuses to play along, Buddy is not pleased and cracks begin to appear in this seemingly perfect world.

A tale of second chances.. happy healing and bitter sweet closures.

Branding himself as a victim, Ricardo Barreda ignited a media storm and fueled a national scandal.

title: Ebre / Trarza

While the Global North is a major contributor to climate change, its devastating effects are most felt in the Global South, particularly in regions like Trarza, Mauritania, where agriculture is severely impacted. Similarly, the Terres de l’Ebre in Catalonia faces rising sea levels and land erosion, threatening local livelihoods. These shared challenges provide a rich opportunity for youth from both regions to engage in dialogue and storytelling.

title: The Invisibles
overview: The story follows a family of five, living quietly and away from prying eyes on the Izu Islands—including the youngest daughter, born invisible. Their mother, who had raised her cheerfully, has passed away from illness, and their anxious father has devoted himself to hiding his daughters from the world. One day, however, they must set out on a journey to visit their grandmother, a famous actress living in Tokyo.

title: King KOSOKO
overview: Warrior Kosoko, grandson of King Ologun Kutere, survives childhood curses to become a formidable prince. When his father, Esinlokun, dies, Kosoko is sidelined as his younger brother Idewu and later his uncle Adele Ajosun usurp the throne. Kosoko bides his time, amassing wealth through trade and alliances.

title: Another
overview: Joey, an author struggling to cope after her brilliant scientist husband, Ben, tragically dies. When Joey wakes one morning to find Ben making pancakes in their kitchen—as if nothing ever happened—her reality begins to fracture.

title: Starsuckers
overview: A celebrity couple invite two of their biggest fans for a weekend escape, with each duo harbouring an ulterior motive.

title: Kiku Chiranjeevi
overview: A young man named Chiru, born with dextrocardia-a rare condition where his heart is on the right side of his chest faces struggles and challenges as he works to overcome his condition and achieve his goals.

title: The Brook
overview: Moving to the village of his mother’s youth, art student Jacob discovers his grandad’s old video camera shows one hour into the past. In Elmbrook, a place steeped in strange folklore and whispered legends, the community believe their village is protected by a puma that watches over the “good.” But when one of the good locals mysteriously vanishes, Jacob and his friends, armed with the video camera, uncover clues that pull them deeper into Elmbrook’s bizarre secrets. Soon the search for answers spirals into a dangerous mystery as they uncover a vengeful serial killer with a connection to the past.

title: LEATHERBACK
overview: In 1994, a college film crew began documenting two promising physics students, Yulon Ackster and Anthony Schmitt, as they claimed to have cracked the code of controlling time itself. The project was expunged following a terrorist attack in Melbourne, Florida. This is the unsealed footage of what they found.

title: Much About Love
overview: A TV director returns to her theater roots for a Shakespeare festival and runs into an old flame, rekindling a merry war of wits in this modern retelling of "Much Ado About Nothing."

title: RevPro 14 Year Anniversary Show
overview: Fourteen years of world-class action from Europe’s number one wrestling producers have led to this. On Saturday 29th August 2026, RevPro takes over the iconic OVO ARENA WEMBLEY for its biggest celebration yet—uniting the finest British and international talent for one unforgettable night. Expect championship clashes, dream matches, and the unmatched energy only RevPro fans bring.

title: Erased
overview: When confronted by the now 18-year-old son he dismissed before birth, a high-powered businessman must decide between their potential relationship and a life changing financial opportunity.

title: Heraldry Paranormal
overview: Four paranormal investigators want to find definitive proof of ghosts within Yorkshire, but find themselves at odds with conmen, internet backlash, and terror beyond their expectations.

title: Zip Wire
overview: When she was 13 years old, Amy Watson watched her mother die from an incurable disease. Determined to find a cure, Amy becomes a dedicated researcher at a high-security pharmaceutical company. She struggles with OCD and a fear of heights. When her groundbreaking discovery is stolen and her partner murdered, she’s thrust into a deadly game of cat-and-mouse high in the Dolomite mountains. With no escape except across a treacherous zip wire, Amy must outsmart the attackers, face her debilitating fears, and summon every ounce of courage to protect the research – and herself – before it’s too late.

title: The Robot Chicken [adult swim] 25th Anniversary Special
overview: Follows iconic Adult Swim characters on a cruise ship celebrating the network's 25th anniversary. The cruise turns into a disaster, potentially spelling a watery doom for all aboard.

title: LOOP
overview: In a near-future world where technology has rendered most human labor obsolete, Zoe Pearce, a despairing artist, finds herself selected as a finalist for the universe challenge. This exclusive competition promises membership in humanity's most coveted experience: complete digital personalized immersion, where pain, suffering, and unwanted emotions are eliminated.

title: Soul Snatchers
overview: A man of unwavering convictions returns with his family to the remote island of his childhood to open a music school for orphaned children, but beneath the island's beauty lies an unseen darkness.

title: Bloom
overview: When Lily inherits her great aunt's struggling desert nursery, she devotes herself to bringing it back to life. As her garden flourishes, her need to sustain it becomes something she can no longer control.
